notes.title: Demo Update 09/22/2025
notes.content:
[p]This may be the largest demo update yet, so here goes.[/p][p][/p][p]Thruster control can now be bound to an axis. This was actually in the last update but missed the release notes.  NOTE:  Currently the axis works just like a button, the thrust is either on or off and the axis will NOT have fine control. This may change later but will require a rewrite of the thruster system. I wanted to at least get in for the players who have requested it.[/p][p align="justify"][/p][p align="justify"]Refactored the player bullet impact function when the projectile hits an enemy fighter specifically. The old system spawned the hit effect at the point of impact, but with the speed of combat the target had moved well clear of the impact zone which made the effect spawn far out behind it. The new system detects and relocates these hits to where they look more natural.[/p][p][/p][p]The key bind system now supports binding single modifier keys (shift, control, alt) independently or as a key combination. [/p][p][/p][p]The MP3 player is now available in the training range. It will ignore the “auto- start MP3 on mission load” option, but the pilot can choose to start the MP3 player manually once they formally enter the range.[/p][p][/p][p]The mission area for “Free Exchange” has had more world dressing around the space station.[/p][p][/p][p]I have made some graphical updates to the stations and world objects by adding a subtle metallic map to them.  They only had albedo and normal textures before.  This gives them a deeper color tone and a more appealing look without the normal shimmering edge effects like you get in most space games.[/p][p][/p][p]The enemy turret HUD overlays have new tech to determine if the turret is obscured. Turrets that are behind objects will be displayed as an icon with a line through it, showing that it is obscured from the direct sight of the player.[/p][p][/p][p]Reworked the in cockpit hit sound effects. They were a little flat before, but I feel these are better. I’m not 100% happy with them, but then again, sound is my Achilles heel.[/p][p]
A common ask among players is the addition of repair in the hanger bay. The main issue with this is that not all scenarios have a hangar bay.  So, I’ve created a limited, one shot “nanite repair system” that the player can engage at any point in the mission after the first warning light is lit. It will take 15 seconds for the nanites to complete their limited repair, and the total repair percentage will be determined by the difficulty level set in the options menu. This system is meant to get you out of trouble, but it will not get you back to full HP.  A new input bind for it has been added under the “MODES” section in the control’s menu.[/p][p][/p][p]The difficulty levels have been renamed to be easier to understand. It now uses the standard Hard, Normal, Medium and Easy nomenclatures. The description that shows at the bottom of the options page has also been updated to give the player a good indication of what changes in the game world as these levels change.[/p][p][/p][p]Cheers![/p]

notes.title: Demo Update 06/23/2025
notes.content: [p]Time for a new demo update. I want to keep the demo in-line (as much as possible) with internal changes that I think would allow a potential buyer to get an accurate assessment of the game. Progress has been slow since Feb Next Fest due to real life issues. It’s tough working on this solo, but I’m ready to make the push toward the finish line.[/p][p][/p][p]Release Notes:[/p][p][/p][p]1)  Additional refinements to the mouse steering system. It's finally in a place I'm happy with. I personally don't use mouse controls in my space sims but I have become pretty proficient with this iteration.[/p][p][/p][p]2)  At player request, I've added a subtle and unobtrusive tracking overlay for fighters that are in front of the player but not the current target. It will make fighters, that are some distance away, easier to spot against the blackness of space. This can be turned off in the options menu if desired.[/p][p][/p][p]3) All radar and tracking HUD options have been enabled by default in the options menu, but can be toggled off, individually, if desired.[/p][p][/p][p]4) Subtitles have been enabled by default in the options menu.[/p][p][/p][p]5) The overall audio has been boosted when maxing out the master game volume slider in the options menu. This may require some further sound balancing going forward.[/p][p][/p][p]6)  Added a main menu notification to inform mouse users that they need to activate mouse steering in the menu options as it is disabled by default. This notice can be permanently toggled off.[/p][p][/p][p]7)  Mouse cursor now hidden during first run story introduction sequence.[/p][p][/p][p]Please post any bugs to the BlackStar Ranger discussion forum. There is a dedicated sub-forum for demo bugs.[/p][p][/p][p]I don't anticipate any issues with previous save files, but if needed, delete the save file in the following location and the game will build a new one.[/p][p]Save File Location:  <DRIVE_LETTER>:\\Users\\<USER_NAME>\\AppData\\LocalLow\\Vandal GameWorx\\save.bin[/p][p][/p][p]Thanks!![/p]

notes.title: Demo Update 01/25/2025
notes.content:
This is a small QOL update:

Continued refinement to the mouse steering system for those without joysticks. The combat in BSR is geared toward HOTAS control, but the game has a mouse steering system as well that I haven't been completely happy with. This update scraps the more math-based sensitivity ramp that the previous system had and now uses a curve-based approach. The increase and decrease in sensitivity when dragging the mouse gizmo is now much smoother and less dramatic. I'm not a mouse using space simmer, but for those who are, I hope this feels better.  REMEMBER:  The lower difficulty levels (Level1 and Level2) will lower the AI maneuverability and armor rating that will help when using mouse control.

Added a new option in the graphics list, at player request, to toggle the ambient space dust if desired.

notes.title: EMERGENCY HOTFIX
notes.content: Fixed an option menu bug in the demo that caused all radio button options not to save their state on menu exit. This was accidently introduced in the update build a week ago. Thanks to Steam user "Dating" for bringing this glaring issue to my attention.

notes.title: DEMO UPDATE 3
notes.content:
RELEASE NOTES:

This "should" be the final build before the February Steam Next-Fest.

Removed the old target arrow system that relied on an overlay canvas and wrote a new system. The new system moves the pointer into 3D space. This makes it more graphically in line with the rest of the holographic HUD.

Reworked some menu UI elements.

Enabled the intro text screen. It will only play on the first session run. (unless you do a full character reset)

The Private Messages screen is now active with the default message included. It will not receive any new messages in the demo.

The Compendium page layout is now visible when the button is selected but has not been populated with any information.

A new option to unlock all contracts has been added to the options page. The normal flow of gameplay is the player unlocks the next contract after completing the previous. This being a single player experience and me believing in player choice, this option will make all contracts available when selected. This is not functional for the demo.

Tweaked the AI pilots to be a little more aggressive.

Various minor bug fixes.

notes.title: Demo Update 2
notes.content:
The second mission has been permanently unlocked in the demo. This will give players a chance to experience what it's like to battle a single enemy cruiser.

At player request, the throttle system has had some changes. Now HOSAS players who want to use their throttle stick for forward and reverse can now do so. When the throttle stick is setup in the calibration window as -1 to 1, by setting the zero slider to the center, the negative portion of the axis will now fire the reverse thruster. This can also be used with keyboard control as long as the Throttle Locking setting is not active. The left MFD will show three red throttle marks at the bottom when the reverse thruster is engaged.

The left, right and reverse thrusters have been buffed to give them the same strength as the up and down thrusters.

Additional changes to difficulty levels. Now levels 1 & 2 will scale down the AI fighters armor rating along with their maneuverability.

Explosions now inherit the velocity of the object that was destroyed and no longer sit static at the point of detonation.

Fixed a bug causing the Steam player name to stop being displayed on the contracts page after entering and exiting a mission.

Further improvements to player cockpit visual hit effects.

Improvements to internal hit sound effects and positional orientation.

Refinements to the mouse steering system. It will now be less sensitive at lower input levels and more sensitive at the limit.

Increased the upper limit of the mouse steering sensitivity setting in the options menu.

Other various minor bug fixes.

notes.title: Demo Update 1
notes.content:
[b]IMPORTANT NOTICE: [/b]  You will need to update your difficulty selection in the options menu for this build. 


* Reworked and added difficulty levels to include AI scaling for those not using HOTAS controls.

* Fixed incorrect scaling of ballistic impacts on player ship.

* Made ballistic rounds fired at player easier to see.

* Updated turret firing parameters that were accidentally changed in the training area during a script update.
